profiles.kind.vless_reality_vision.title: VLESS Reality
profiles.kind.vless_reality_vision.desc: The main option: fast and indistinguishable from plain HTTPS.
profiles.kind.vless_reality_xhttp.title: VLESS XHTTP
profiles.kind.vless_reality_xhttp.desc: A fallback for networks that cut long TCP connections.
profiles.kind.hysteria2.title: Hysteria2
profiles.kind.hysteria2.desc: For poor and mobile networks: runs over UDP.
profiles.fields.name.label: Name
profiles.fields.name.hint: How the profile is named in the user's app.
profiles.fields.port.label: Port
profiles.fields.port.hint: 443 looks like ordinary HTTPS. Change it if the port is taken.
profiles.fields.serverNames.label: Disguise domain
profiles.fields.serverNames.hint: The site the connection imitates. Separate several with commas.
profiles.fields.target.label: Target address
profiles.fields.target.hint: Where Xray forwards foreign requests. Usually the disguise domain and port 443.
profiles.fields.fingerprint.label: Browser fingerprint
profiles.fields.fingerprint.hint: Which browser the client's TLS handshake imitates.
profiles.fields.shortIds.label: Short ID
profiles.fields.shortIds.hint: Short hex labels, separated by commas. Rarely needs changing.
profiles.fields.privateKey.label: Reality private key
profiles.fields.privateKey.hint: After replacing the key everyone needs to refresh the subscription.
profiles.fields.path.label: Path
profiles.fields.path.hint: Server path that carries XHTTP traffic. Must start with /.
profiles.fields.mode.label: XHTTP mode
profiles.fields.mode.hint: auto picks the best transfer method for each client.
profiles.fields.obfs.label: Salamander obfuscation
profiles.fields.obfs.hint: Hides QUIC traffic. Without it Hysteria2 is easier to spot.
profiles.fields.obfsPassword.label: Obfuscation password
profiles.fields.obfsPassword.hint: Shared by all clients of the profile. Refresh subscriptions after changing it.
